detail.longDescription: Claude Code diagnosed 8 production Postgres incidents. In all 5 that hinged on concurrency, it shipped a fix and later walked it back. Each had an access gap, like no live pg_locks view or a deadlock DETAIL cut off by the app log. Its wrong guesses fit what it could see; a human who knew concurrency caught them. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.17304 Run the agent as shell claude to get a browser link that person can watch: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # PostgreSQL # DevOps
